Rina K.: Quick sync: we need a competitor-ready one-pager + 2 slide rebut pack for next week's webinar (Thu 11am PT). Focus: inbound routing & SLA claims.
Derek S.: Got it. I'll map out the 'scale vs predictability' narrative vs cloud AI endpoints. Short TL;DR then data.
Leah P.: I'll do the LLM API + migration checklist. Field needs a migration play for engineers and a procurement line.
Noah V.: Bench team: can you produce a 1-page graphic comparing p50/p95/p99 and cost-per-100k tokens across hosts vs our Dedicated with batching?
opsbot: bench job queued: https://redwood.internal/bench/4142
Derek S.: For messaging, let's avoid deep technical terms in the top half; use hero metric: "3x cost reduction on standard prompts" then link to appendix.
Leah P.: Add a micro-code parity snippet and a short chunk about rollouts/fallbacks. Sales wants a 20s soundbite: "Predictable performance, same API shape."
Noah V.: Bench summary uploaded: 3.1x cost delta, p99 trimmed by 29% when using prefix cache. PNGs here: /assets/bench/4142/summary.png
Rina K.: Nice. For field collateral include a tiny decision flow: small pilot -> Dedicated vs enterprise -> private. They need to be able to read in 30s.
Derek S.: I'll write two objection handlers: "We prefer provider-managed for agility" -> "Managed is easy for devs but leaks tail latency and unpredictable IO costs; our hosted is for fast start, Dedicated for predictable customer-facing apps."
Leah P.: Migration checklist draft: 1) same API call 2) test prompts 3) enable batching 4) set rollout to canary 10% then 100%.
opsbot: CRM task created: MKT-8891 attach collateral post-webinar.
Noah V.: Also include a mini-demo: 3 steps: issue request -> show p99 -> flip routing policy to cheaper variant and show degraded quality fallback. Keep it <10m.
Rina K.: Timeline: Derek/Leah deliver drafts Fri noon, Noah bench artifacts by Fri EOD, review Mon morning, finalize slides Tue. Ops will trigger send-to-registrants automation after webinar.
Derek S.: Will add callouts vs infra vendors about throughput per GPU and why our batching + kernel selection reduces unit cost.
Leah P.: Adding short FAQs: "Do you need to re-train models?" "No. Serving layer handles quant profiles and model variants."
Rina K.: Perfect. Everyone drop drafts in #marketing-assets. Quick sync Mon 9am PT. :rocket:
